messages:
mira: Quick post-launch triage — we shipped v1.2 yesterday. Three follow-ons: (A) Zeno customer reports embedding drift affecting search relevance, (B) p95 latency bump on chat after batching tweak, (C) simple UX ask for token-limit affordance. Need owners + priority.

tom: Can we get the Zeno traces? If it's a regression we should hotpatch.

harper: Ticket ZENO-12: their search recall dropped ~30% starting 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. They say intermittent older vectors show up in results. Marked P0 by CS.

ivy: Infra note: compaction job concurrency was increased in the last deploy. We saw a short window of write contention and some "kv_read_stale" warnings. Could match ZENO timeline.

em: UX ask is just a small affordance: show "approx tokens used" + hover copy. Design work ~3-4 hrs, dev ~4 hrs. Low risk, high perceived polish.

mira: My suggestion: ZENO-12 = P0 hotfix (rollback compaction concurrency + run reconcile), chat p95 = P1 investigation (pause aggressive batching if correlated), token affordance = P3 (next sprint unless we have slack). Agree?

tom: I can own ZENO hotfix. Plan: revert concurrency flag, add one-shot reconcile to reindex recent writes, add a smoke test replaying Zeno's failing trace. Est 1.5 dev days + 0.5 verif. Need SRE to run canary.

ivy: I'll repro in staging and prepare a 5% canary plan with smoke checks. Will capture KV metrics and prepare rollback steps.

triage-bot: Branch created: hotfix/zeno-reconcile-1843219999. CI status: running. (automated)

harper: Success criteria for ZENO-12: recall back to baseline for 24h post-rollout, no stale-vector alerts for 48h, customer confirmation. I'll hold customer comms until 25% canary green.

em: I'll prepare the hover copy and a tiny mock. If engineering has a half-day spare we can land the affordance quickly.

tom: For chat p95 Ill add logging around batching decisions and run a short AB that reverts batching thresholds for a subset of traffic to compare. Owner: tom.

mira: Decision log: ZENO-12 -> P0 hotfix (tom + ivy). Chat p95 -> P1 investigation (tom). Token affordance -> P3 (em). Timeline: staging canary tonight, prod ramp if green tomorrow morning. Follow-up async update here + 9am PT check-in. :thumbsup:

tom: Opening PR with reconcile + smoke harness now.

ivy: After canary Ill run a p95 baseline replay for chat to verify any side effects.

harper: Posting ZENO comms draft to the ticket; will send after 25% canary success.

mira: Thanks team  Ill update roadmap notes and bump priorities in the backlog.
